item.title: Accomodation
item.description: Comfortable accommodation options arranged for tourists UD Travel ensures safe place and sound sleep of tourist after every tiring day imperatively. In this respect, we always arrange relaxed ambience for night halts according to the demand of tourists. Apart from facilitating Hotel Reservation, we provide Home-Stay service in the village for reasonable price with an aim, not only for one time experience and entertainment but to embed cultivation of inter-relationship between host family and tourists through direct interaction and exchange of shared socio-cultural values.
